newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle not fully established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle not fully established - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not fully established, compared with Tuesday's close, with a higher undertone noted, USDA said.
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1275 lbs few 70.00
Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150 lbs few 70.75
On a carcass basis, steers and heifers were $1.00 higher in a light test.
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs 111.00
Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs 111.00
Reported sales for Wed: 800. Week to Date: 23,200
